items.comparator: Conventional R&D; the source does not specify the benchmark method or study design.
items.quantitative_outcome: Holyvolt said its automated lab “already delivers results 10 times faster than conventional R&D.” It also said that “closing the loop with AI lets us move 100 times faster.” The latter is a claimed potential, not a separately measured result.
items.signal: The company reported a speed advantage from its automated battery-materials lab and AI-linked experimental feedback loop. It also described a proprietary dataset covering more than 500,000 physical cells tested over more than 165 million cycles—a potentially difficult-to-recreate data asset. Treat the speed figures as company claims; the source gives no independent validation or detailed comparator.
items.source: Holyvolt press release carried by WebWire

items.comparator: Blinded reports generated by single AI agents; for the 32-minute result, an estimated months to a year of serial human analysis and literature review.
items.quantitative_outcome: The company said its agent system analyzed its whole-brain atlas and synthesized findings in 32 minutes, versus an estimated months to a year for serial human analysis and literature review. In blinded comparisons, human biology experts preferred the system's interpretations 75% of the time over reports from single AI agents.
items.signal: AI agents applied to a proprietary whole-brain causal genomic dataset; the report also says the collaboration is expanding into joint drug-target discovery. The speed comparison is against an estimate, and the preference result is against single-agent AI—not a demonstrated improvement in drug discovery yield.
items.source: PerturbAI and OpenAI announcement, distributed via PR Newswire and reported by Yahoo Finance

items.signal: FactSet partnered with Nasdaq Private Market to integrate documented, auditable private-company capitalization-table data into FactSet Workstation. The companies say this data can support due diligence, valuation analysis, and deal sourcing; no measured operating benefit was reported. This is a distinctive data-access signal that could become an advantage, not evidence of realized advantage.

Canoe and Landytech announced automated delivery of extracted alternative-investment data into Landytech’s Sesame platform, replacing manual data entry for mutual clients. The announcement describes less manual entry and reconciliation, but states no measured quantity or comparison.

items.comparator: In selected experiments, about €0.03 per request using smaller specialized models versus roughly €5 using large general-purpose models; a separate customer-service experiment compared costs with its prior level, which was not specified in the search result.
items.quantitative_outcome: “serving a request in selected experiments cost about €0.03 with smaller, specialized models, compared with roughly €5 using large, general-purpose models.” Separately: “costs fell by more than 50% as conversation quality improved.” The report says Santander described both results as experimental.
items.signal: A reported experimental cost reduction in model-serving and customer-service workflows. The result is potentially meaningful, but the source characterizes the findings as experiments rather than established operational performance; the customer-service baseline is not stated.

items.comparator: Year-to-date usage; the article also compares tool-call activity with the prior six months, but provides no operating workflow baseline.
items.quantitative_outcome: “more than 21,000 users across 3,000 accounts have made more than 10 million tool calls to PitchBook data through AI platforms”; “Usage has accelerated nearly 2,000% year to date, with tool calls up 267% in the last six months alone.”
items.signal: Reported AI-platform use of PitchBook’s private-market data is growing, indicating data distribution and adoption. These are usage figures, not a measured operating benefit or proof of competitive advantage.
items.source: Business Wire release carried by FT.com, reporting PitchBook

items.comparator: Frontier AI labs, in L3Harris’s internal test environment; the specific labs, test design, and baseline are not stated.
items.quantitative_outcome: L3Harris Chief Transformation Officer Heidi Wood said: “In a few days we were able to outperform the frontier labs in our test environment and cut costs by 95%.” The source does not specify the cost baseline or evaluation method.
items.signal: L3Harris reports a potentially meaningful cost and performance result from testing sovereign models on internal work, alongside use of its own enterprise data. Treat as a weak signal: the comparison and measurement details are undisclosed, and the statement appears in a partner announcement.
items.source: Palantir Technologies, company announcement distributed by Business Wire

items.quantitative_outcome: “typical throughput improvements of 10% to 15%” from AI-based uplink channel estimation in initial lab measurements.
items.signal: AI-enhanced channel estimation in a 5G radio receiver produced a measured uplink-throughput improvement in laboratory validation. This is a preliminary operating-benefit signal, not evidence of a sustained competitive advantage; field trials were planned for 2027.
